Kratom Use Then Taking Naltroxone
I will make this short.  I have been using kratom with oxycodone for the past year.  I quit taking the oxycodone about 42 days ago while taking kratom. I had a mild withdraw from the oxycodone.
I continued my use of kratom probably 40-60 grams a day.  Yesterday my counselor dared me to take a 50mg naltrexone we did not know what would happen.  Within 20 minutes of taking the naltrexone I was violently ill.  I spent the next 24 hours wishing I was dead.  I have been an opiate addict for a long time, this was by far the worst I have ever felt.  Every feeling that you could imagine that comes with withdrawal I was feeling, could not sleep.  It ruined me for 24 hours.
The reason I am writing this is so no one ever has to feel the way I did by taking naltrexone why under the influence of kratom.  I would not take any naltrexone for at least 2-3 days after quitting kratom.
